key_insight: Genetic algorithms design interpretable spatial descriptors that balance local-response prediction error against the number of image-derived features.
engineering_relevance: Explicit regional measurements help identify where surrounding structure needs fine spatial detail and where compact summaries may suffice for property prediction.
method: Benchmark regression models and inspect spatial attribution with SHAP maps.
Evaluate image patch size and compression to probe accuracy–dimensionality trade-offs.
Evolve Cartesian and polar partitions with mean, minimum, and maximum pooling.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports evaluation on local spectra and hysteresis-loop prediction, but provides no dataset sizes or quantitative performance metrics.
watch_item: Extension to molecules and solids remains conditional on defining suitable genetic-algorithm rules.
paper_title: Evolutionary Design of Interpretable Spatial Descriptors for Structure-Property Relationship Discovery
